analysis: Praziquantel is an anthelmintic medication primarily used to treat infections caused by certain types of parasitic worms, particularly schistosomiasis, which is caused by trematodes (flukes). It is not effective for strongyloidiasis, trichomoniasis, or rhinosporidiosis.
